ability_tensura.msg.preset_full: Your Tensura ability bar is full - free a slot first
ability_tensura.configuration.gate.toolt: What the Tensura unlock gate enforces.
ability_tensura.configuration.activation: How activations map onto ARR's preset slots.
ability_tensura.configuration.menu.toolt: Menu preferences for this mod's tabs and rows.
ability_tensura.configuration.tabs.toolt: Which of this mod's tabs appear in the ability menu.
ability_tensura.configuration.requireUnl: Refuse activating an art the player has not learned in Tensura. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.removeUnle: When a skill is forgotten, clear it from every hotbar bar - and sweep unlearned assignments at login. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.hideUnlear: Hide arts the player has not learned from the ability menu; known and learned arts always list. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.knownMinMa: Minimum mastery before a merely known art lists in the menu. Default: 0 (more than zero).
ability_tensura.configuration.resistance: Minimum mastery before a resistance lists in the menu. Default: 0 (more than zero).
ability_tensura.configuration.presetMapp: How hotbar bars map onto ARR's preset slots. Default: Tail.
ability_tensura.configuration.autoEquipO: Casting an art that is not in ARR's preset places it in the first free slot (a full preset refuses). Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.skills.too: Show the Skills tab in the ability menu. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.magic.tool: Show the Magic tab in the ability menu. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.battlewill: Show the Battlewill tab in the ability menu. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.showChipIc: Draw the subcategory chips' sprite icons (off = text-only chips). Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.skillsSubC: Subcategory order of the Skills tab's filter strip.
ability_tensura.configuration.tabOrder.t: Order of this mod's menu tabs: any of skills, magic, battlewill.
ability_tensura.configuration.replaceTrs: Replace Tensura Evolution's equip-skills screens with this mod's ability menu (when both mods are loaded). Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.showMaster: Show the Mastery progress field on menu rows. Default: on.
ability_tensura.configuration.showStatus: Show the Status field (Known / Learned / Mastered) on menu rows. Default: on.
ability_tensura.preset_mapping.head: Head (bar 0 = first preset)
